integrity: The result is a mathematical deduction for the stated stochastic model. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal friction and bath temperatures; common isotropic harmonic trap; fixed finite positive spring constants; two dimensions.
Nonzero-rest-length dissipative coefficient is an exact reversible generator resolvent, not generally an elementary function.
Full joint nonequilibrium stationary density and finite-time entropy fluctuations are not computed.
title: An equilibrium bond hides exact finite-rest-length dissipation in a nonreciprocal Brownian dimer
